description: This Java class implements the NotificationMapperReadRepositoryWrapper interface, providing methods to access NotificationMapper entities via an underlying NotificationMapperRepository. It is annotated as a Spring service with required dependencies injected, and provides methods to find by ID, fetch all notifications, and delete notifications.

classes.name: NotificationMapperReadRepositoryWrapperImpl
classes.description: A Spring service class that wraps a NotificationMapperRepository to provide read operations for NotificationMapper entities.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a NotificationMapper entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: fetchAllNotifications
methods.description: Fetches all NotificationMapper entities from the repository.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a NotificationMapper entity by its ID.
